summary: The password_hash filter itself is unchanged, but because utils.encrypt moved from passlib to libcrypt/libxcrypt its hashes are valid yet differ from earlier output for the same input.
questions: Why does password_hash give a different hash in ansible-core 2.21?
Do password_hash results from ansible-core 2.21 still work for logins?

answer_card.title: password_hash output changed
answer_card.answer_md: The `password_hash` filter is unchanged, but it depends on `utils.encrypt`, which moved from passlib (deprecated) to **libcrypt/libxcrypt**. It still creates **valid** hashes, but they are not identical to the previous ones for the same input. Expect changed output (and possibly reported changes) in tasks that compare hashes.
